prompt: This cheerful children's picture book illustration depicts a friendly robot assembly line with soft pastel colors and rounded shapes. In the center foreground, a small blue robot with big eyes holds a shiny red button, offering it to a larger yellow robot standing to its right. The yellow robot smiles broadly, reaching out with metallic fingers to accept the gift. To the left, a green robot sits on a conveyor belt, waving happily at a floating drone overhead. Three other robots stand in the background: one pink, one orange, and one purple, each holding different tools like screwdrivers and paintbrushes. A cute white dog with floppy ears runs between the legs of the central robots, chasing a rolling ball. The conveyor belt moves gently from left to right, carrying boxes of supplies. Overhead lights cast a warm, even glow without harsh shadows, creating a safe and inviting atmosphere. The background features simple geometric factories with smiling windows. The interaction between the blue and yellow robots highlights friendship and cooperation, while the dog adds playful energy. All elements are clearly visible and spaced apart to ensure clarity for young readers, emphasizing simplicity and joy in a technological setting.
